definitions.explanation: A daily written record of events and personal thoughts.

examples.japanese: {日記|にっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}した→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{日記|にっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いています→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write in my diary every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日記|にっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦きて→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦みたら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしかった→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧。
examples.english: My diary from childhood turned up, and reading it brought back fond memories.

notes:
{日記|にっき} refers to a personal record of daily events and thoughts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日記|にっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in a diary
- {日記|にっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep a diary
- {日記|にっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧: to reread one's diary

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{絵日記|えにっき}→絵日記：noentry⟧: picture diary (common school assignment)
- ⟦{日記帳|にっきちょう}→日記帳：22091_nikkichou⟧: diary notebook
- ⟦ブログ→ブログ：05104_burogu⟧: blog (modern online diary)
- ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧{日記|にっき}: exchange diary (shared between friends)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Keeping a diary is a common practice in Japan, often assigned as homework in elementary schools.
